title: HamletMon
description: HamletMon Ads unice Pokemon style cards which you can show off to your friends, collect or hang on your walls. So Go Collect them All!
body:
HamletMon is a collectible card mod that adds Pokémon-style cards to Minecraft. Open booster packs, collect different cards, trade or show them to your friends, and decorate your base by placing your favorite cards on the wall using item frames!

# Features
Open booster packs to receive random HamletMon cards
Collect a growing set of unique cards
Show your cards to friends
Display cards on walls with item frames
Build your own card collection room
Perfect for SMPs, roleplay servers, and collectors
How It Works

Find or obtain a HamletMon Booster Pack, open it, and receive random collectible cards. Some cards may be more common, while others are harder to find, making every pack exciting to open.

You can keep your cards in chests, trade them with other players, or place them in item frames to show off your rarest pulls.

HamletMon adds a fun collecting system to Minecraft without changing the core gameplay too much. It gives players another reason to explore, trade, decorate, and interact with each other on multiplayer servers.

Whether you want to complete the full collection, decorate your base, or flex your rare cards to your friends, HamletMon brings a fun card-collecting experience into Minecraft.

Great For
SMP servers
Community servers
Roleplay worlds
Collectors
Decoration lovers
Players who enjoy opening packs and finding rare items

Start opening booster packs and build the ultimate HamletMon card collection!
